animated_runner_and_track_design.runner_mascot: Animated SVG Running Sprint Silhouette with Sky-Blue (#38BDF8) dynamic stride motion & particle speed trails.
animated_runner_and_track_design.track_layout: Responsive horizontal scrollable / curved 62-step progression track with glowing teal node markers, milestone checkpoints, and real-time runner position pin.
animated_runner_and_track_design.running_animation_behavior: Smooth CSS @keyframes sprint bobbing + SVG legs movement along track percentage: (Completed_Days / 62) * 100%.
animated_runner_and_track_design.reduced_motion_fallback: Replaces continuous running animation with a crisp, static high-contrast location marker icon and instant progress bar fill for reduced motion preference (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`).

trophy_milestones.title: 45-Day Supercharged Elite
trophy_milestones.hinglish_note: Day 45 Streak Supercharged 🔥 - Rank Booster Mode!

states_and_handling.prelaunch_state: Countdown to Dec 1, 2026 with unlocked warm-up streak pledge button.
states_and_handling.active_daily_state: Today's Live Test status highlight: 'Aaj Ka Test Completed! Streak Safe! 🏆' or 'Aaj Ka Test Pending - 3 Hours Mock Baaki Hai! ⏳'
states_and_handling.missed_day_state: Honest non-fabricated completion tracking. Displays streak broken notice with 'Streak Freeze / Buffer Attempt' options without falsifying historical test submission logs.
states_and_handling.completed_state: Confetti celebration modal with shareable report card card layout.

integration_points.type: Compact 62-Day Streak Widget with mini runner progress, current streak counter, and direct 'Continue Streak' CTA button.
Full-width Interactive 62-Day Sprint Hub featuring dynamic track visualization, Cup Milestones gallery, detailed streak statistics, and day-by-day test selector grid.

key_user_requirements.action: Incorporate a 62-day completion streak (1 Dec 2026 - 31 Jan 2027) with running runner mascot animation and animated progress track.
Render animated trophy milestones (Day 7 Bronze, Day 15 Silver, Day 30 Gold, Day 45 Diamond, Day 62 Grand Champion) with honest celebration modal upon milestone unlock.
Display Personal Current Streak, Best Streak, and Completed Tests out of 62 with Hinglish motivational copy (e.g., '62 Din Target JEE Mains!').
Provide reduced-motion support, prelaunch countdown state, and accurate non-fabricated missed day state handling.
Integrate compact streak progress into Home dashboard banner and full interactive sprint hub in `/series/all-india-jee`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Flagship Teal (#0D9488) and Sky-Blue (#0284C7 / #38BDF8) as the primary brand palette with Amber Gold (#F59E0B) for trophy milestones.
Ensure all interactive buttons, streak nodes, trophy cards, and toggle switches contain explicit data-testid attributes.
Support prefers-reduced-motion in CSS animation keyframes and React motion logic.
Do not fake or fabricate completion dates; maintain honest history tracking.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always include data-testid on interactive and key status components using kebab-case.
Do not center-align the main App container text globally.
Maintain contrast accessibility in both light and dark themes.
Use Sonner for user toast notifications.
